My tracking says delivered but I didn't receive it, what now?
If the tracking indicates delivered but you did not receive the package, please follow these steps:
Check around the delivery location
Inspect doors, side entrances, mailrooms, lockers, porch areas, or inquire with building staff.
Ask household members or neighbors in case the package was accepted on your behalf.
Allow additional time
Occasionally, carriers mark a package as delivered before it actually arrives.
Contact the carrier
NANUK regular orders typically ship with UPS Ground. UPS may be able to provide further delivery details.
Contact us if the package does not arrive
You may reach us through our contact page or at info@nanuk.com.
